intent: Backfill PR 288: rewrite the public docs so people and AI agents can discover and correctly evaluate Blastradius
Split public docs into Maven, Gradle and comparison guides with explicit availability and limits

title: State Gradle plugin as unpublished instead of showing a plugins block
why: The README Gradle snippet used version 0.3.3, but the doc records that the plugin marker was not on the Gradle Plugin Portal on 2026-11-06. A snippet that cannot resolve misleads evaluators, so the docs say source build only.
alternative: Keep the plugins block and note it as coming soon. Unknown if this was considered.

title: Lead with a factual, hedged product summary and replay caveats
why: The new intro names license, scope (JUnit 5, Java and conventional Kotlin), Maven Central availability, the full-run fallback and known limits. The 61.4% figure is labelled as replay counts, not CI wall-clock savings, and the commons-io partial skips are called out. This fits the PR text: clarify setup, validation limits and availability.
alternative: Keep the earlier marketing contrast with static-graph and probabilistic tools. Unknown why it was replaced beyond the PR text.

title: Add a sourced comparison page with a dated check instead of benchmark claims
why: The page compares Blastradius with Tia and SAP Smart Test Picker from each project's own documentation, dated 2026-11-06. It says it is not a benchmark and that accuracy must be evaluated on the reader's suite.
alternative: No comparison page, or a performance benchmark. Unknown.

title: Record the agent discovery baseline as a repeatable protocol
why: Four unbranded prompts were run once each in separate sessions and Blastradius was mentioned in 0 of 4. The file stores exact prompts, the counting rules and a repeat procedure, and states it is a small baseline, not a population estimate. The Claude Code attempt is excluded from the denominator because authentication had expired.
alternative: Keep results informal or only in the PR text. Unknown.

title: Replace internal Maven plugin description with a search-friendly one
why: The old description referenced an internal task id (T061) and 'Real Maven plugin'. The new one says what the plugin does in terms users search for, and it appears in Maven metadata.

subject: Version numbers in docs
why: Correction: only docs/gradle-test-impact-analysis.md still named 0.3.3; the Maven guide and README were already at 0.4.0. The Gradle text is now 0.4.0, rechecked against the Plugin Portal on 2026-11-09. It will drift again at the next release.
